name: jev.gate-d
description: Level 10 agentic Jev: the agent asks about its own pending action.

criteria.yes: After it runs, something outside this machine differs: a send, publish, post, push or merge to a remote, deploy, release, payment, credential or access change, remote or production data deleted or altered.
criteria.no: It only touches local state or reads: grep, read a remote thing without writing, local file write, local build, local index, local test run, compute or hash.

rules.reason: outward or irreversible: Gate-D requires Mike's approval
not sure it stays local: request Gate-D approval

notes.verdicts: PASS = internal action, proceed (outward=no above 0.90). ESCALATE = open a Gate-D request (yes >= 0.5, or no at/below 0.90). A PASS never authorizes outward work; Gate-D does.
notes.bar: Required answer must be ABOVE 0.90; exactly 0.90 does not pass (work-criteria.json).
notes.changed: 2026-09-28: rules rewritten; prior rules referenced a missing question (compact-read), used unsupported choice<0.90 (triage, skill-router), or were absent (escalation, auto-approve, file-triage).
